name: anthem-game
description: Open `index.html` to play the garden locally. For the YouTube soundtrack, run `python3 -m http.server 8080` from this folder and open http://localhost:8080. No build or installation is needed. YouTube requires an internet connection; all garden artwork is generated locally.
